response.original_title: Time and Chance: Gerald Ford's Appointment with History
response.overview: This hour long feature documentary was produced to commemorate the life of 38th President Gerald R. Ford. This film traces Ford's adolescence growing up in Grand Rapids, Michigan through his formative years and chronicles his political career from Michigan's twelve-term Congressman to Vice President to President. This film features interviews with Former Vice President Richard B. Cheney, Former Presidents George H. Bush and Jimmy Carter, Senator Edward Kennedy, Michigan Governor Jennifer Granholm, Secretary of State Colin Powell and Former Secretary of State and Nobel Peace Prize winner Henry Kissinger. Broadcast worldwide after his death this documentary was nominated for an Emmy Award in 2004.
response.title: Time and Chance: Gerald Ford's Appointment with History
